svg.title: OpenMP CPU occupancy
svg.desc: Close is on the left and spread on the right, grouped by thread count. Each panel has 64 CPU slots, ordered by CPU ID. Each cell shows CPU ID followed by the recorded tids; gray means no recorded thread.
svg.text: Each cell: CPU ID : tid | Gray = no recorded thread
Sources: 6 files / 12 snapshots | CPU ID from the recorded cpu column
